definition: AMF full six-workstream deployment completion; 100-point evidence-weighted binary gate system
change_policy: Never alter a v1 milestone ID, weight or acceptance criterion. Add a new version and explicit old-to-new restatement with human approval for scope changes.
scoring: Every gate is 0 or full fixed points; no fractional completion; unverified or stale evidence=0. 100 points require ALL 43 independent milestones. Does not measure time remaining.

milestones.title: Six approved minimum knowledge excerpts
